newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SHK Prop unit mandates HK$5.0 bln loan.
newsitem.headline: SHK Prop unit mandates HK$5.0 bln loan.

text.p: Six banks have been mandated by Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd as co-ordinating arrangers for its HK$5.0 billion revolving credit/term loan facility, bankers said.
The six co-ordinating arrangers are Hang Seng Finance, Sumitomo Bank Hong Kong, Societe Generale Asia, Chase Manhattan Asia, BNP Hong Kong and Standard Chartered Bank.
The facility will launch through the company's subsidiary Sun Hung Kai Properties (Financial Services) Ltd. It carries a maturity of seven years and has an average life of 5.75 years.
An expanded arranger group is being formed.
